comment: pages.yml's action jobs: actions/pages run on Git Crafter itself, as any repo would call it. It names its own maps (maps.json) and its own Quality config (config/quality.json), and nothing else. Its own_repo defaults to its first repo. Its map steps read that Quality page's data/quality/latest.json, else local.json, never another repo's. A job that builds no Quality page first reads none, and its map steps say so.
heading: git-crafter
